item.description: GT Resources # For any resources related to Student Engagement and Wellbeing such as Dean of Student’s contacts, Library, etc., please refer to this LINK Class Resources # Main Course Reference # The main reference for this course is Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning (PRML) by Christopher M. Bishop. The course is based primarily on this book, with lecture materials and assigned readings providing additional coverage. A free official PDF is available, so purchasing a printed copy is not required.
